text:
elena: Quick heads-up — All-hands tomorrow 10:00am PT (45m). Short agenda: 1) Exec snapshot (hiring + runway), 2) Product launch callouts for Optimize beta, 3) Ops: brief incident recap, 4) Policy update (PTO carryover & remote work refresh), 5) Q&A. Please drop any questions here by EOD. Recording and slides will be posted after.

maria: Adding an anonymous form for question collection here: https://tiny.redwood/qna-form :smile: Please share any sensitive questions there.

raj: Will cover launch metrics (engagement + latency) and rollout plan. Planning a phased ramp with Dedicated customers first. cc @eng-sre for outage notes.

jordan: I'll post a concise incident timeline and our mitigations in this thread after morning stand. Working on the slides for what failed and how we changed autoscale tests.

sam: Quick ask — can the deck include a one-slide runbook link and the new SDK changelog? Makes it easier for teams to triage post-meeting.

ops-bot: Reminder: All-hands event added to calendar — 2026-03-24 17:00 UTC (10:00 PT). Join link in the invite.

elena: Also important: policy update we want to announce publicly in the meeting — PTO carryover will be capped to 10 days starting July 1. We'll explain rationale and exceptions at the meeting.

maria: I'll assemble a FAQ doc and post to #people-ops after the meeting. If you'd like to preview the policy, DM me.

raj: If anyone in beta has a strong customer quote for Optimize, ping me — would like 1–2 short blurbs to mention during the call.

sam: I'll make sure the recording link and slides go into the all-hands thread within 2 hours after the meeting.

elena: If you can't make it, watch the recording. Managers: please cascade major takeaways to your squads.

jordan: Incident recap (short): last Thursday our prefix-cache cluster hit OOM during peak traffic due to a misconfigured autoscale policy + high seq-length bursts. Impacted ~3% of requests for 8 minutes. Rolled back to previous config, added hotfix to cache eviction logic, and locked autoscale tests into CI. Postmortem coming.

elena: Action items for the meeting follow-up: 1) @raj — finalize launch cadence doc + list of beta customers; 2) @jordan — full incident postmortem and SLO proposal; 3) @maria — publish policy FAQ and Q&A digest; 4) @sam — upload deck + recording + runbook link. We'll publish concise notes to #all-hands-feed within 24h.

maria: +1, will tag owners in the FAQ draft.

raj: ack to action items, will share draft by EOD Friday.

sam: ack — prepping deck slides now.

elena: Thanks everyone — looking forward to the sync. If you have lightning demos (2 mins) DM me — we might squeeze one in. :thumbsup:
